doc: Two sheets fan apart along the diagonal and settle back as a stack.
Corners fly outward as a ghost window swells to fill the screen.
Corners draw inward as the ghost window shrinks back to a pane.
The eye dims while the strike is drawn across it, then recovers.
Keys press in a typed (not scanned) order; the space bar finishes.
Knobs slide along their rails, the rails opening around them.

doc: Lifted and jabbed in: the needle sinks on contact, then the pin rests.
The gear clicks forward exactly one tooth; the hub pulses with it.
A page turns over the spine as the book lifts.
Lines light up in reading order, as a voice moves through the text.
The letter springs up from the page, its crossbar lagging a beat.
The lens arcs up over the page, magnifies, and settles back at the corner.
The plus is stamped in with a quarter twist; the book takes the hit.
Dropped in from above, landing with a squash and a flash of fill.
The plus pops, then the lens swells after it.
The minus tucks in before the lens shrinks.
Held by the handle, the magnifier sweeps a small arc over the page.
Heads push to the edges while the bar stretches to fit between them.
Four arrows dive to the centre, heads leading, and ease back out.
The next page rises from beneath as the current one lifts away.

The grid is ruled in: the column line first, then the rows.

Each head tugs away before the shaft relaxes.
Two lanes slide past each other, each in its own direction.
The arrow pushes off from the line, which flexes, and comes round again.
The curve is traced backwards to the head, which nudges as it arrives.
One deliberate half-turn that lands exactly on itself.
The loop runs one cycle: both lanes travel and wrap around in step.
The halves part along the diagonal and click back together.
Rows type themselves out, each line wiping in from its bullet.
The tree unfolds: the trunk draws down, then children slide out of it.
Ticks are drawn one after another; each row nudges as it is checked.
Three dots bounce in turn – the familiar 'more to come' cadence.

doc: A tap: the folder squashes on its base and springs back.
The front flap tips open from its hinge and swings shut again.
The plus drops in from above and the folder bounces on impact.
The lens scans sideways across the folder, tilting with the motion.
The front folder lifts while the back one dips.
The lens runs down the page and pulses when it finds the line.
The activity lights blink out and come back; the drive itself settles.
The arrow drops into the tray, which bounces; the arrow returns from above.
The lid lifts from its hinge; the can shudders and the contents settle.
A button press: the triangle compresses, then lunges forward.
The bars squeeze toward each other and part again – a held breath.

doc: The headphones bob to a beat while an equaliser plays between the cups.
The waveform is traced left to right, then rings out vertically.
The speaker swells and the sound waves ripple outward in turn.
The lattice separates and re-forms.
Rays advance one notch and flare outward while the core pulses.
The moon tips back and two stars twinkle in the gap of its crescent.
Dusk: rays retreat in turn while the inner arc swings round like a shadow.
The shadow swings a full turn around the disc, which dims as it is covered.

doc: The palette tilts as its wells fill.
Three gusts blow through left to right, each drawn in from its tail.
A quick blink, then the pupil glances aside and back.
The marker swipes and a translucent band grows under its tip.
A sweep passes beneath the hopping letter.
The rule is drawn under the letter with a pen; the letter bobs in response.
The rocking pencil leaves a fading scribble.
Pressed on, the note wobbles from its pinned corner and the fold lifts.
The letters take a breath and a spark flicks off the frame's corner.
The die pulses while a pulse of current runs clockwise around the pins.

doc: The units un-stack a touch and re-seat; the LEDs blink in turn.
The key turns about its bow and clicks back.
The strike is slashed across and the sign recoils – denied.
A back-and-forth: the source glyph speaks, then the target letter answers.
The feather lifts and sways from its quill – weightless.
Two lines of text fold into one as the scroll curls, then open out again.
One confident stroke – short leg, then long – with a flick at the end.
The ring pulses once and the tick is drawn into it, settling with a bounce.
The sign shakes as its exclamation stamps.
The hands are wound forward a full turn; the dial swells a touch with them.
